objective: Measured-trace training, auditable held-out forecasts, synchronized repository results and a new PR
hypothesis: Trainable numeric adapters and a cached recurrent predictor around a frozen pretrained transformer can learn five-step measurement forecasts; superiority to simpler baselines is evaluated, not presumed.
primary_metric: MAE in physical units over selected windows and all five steps
guardrails: no target or future receipt/context input
adapter updates verified; frozen language weights unchanged
checkpoint reconstruction and independent metric recomputation
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation MAE; evaluate test after selection
preflight: 118 tests, Ruff lint/format, independent raw reconstruction of 27 samples, train-only real-data canary; optimizer recovery exact
promotion: Publish complete authenticated evidence regardless of rank; do not replace defaults or claim control superiority
limitations: observational targets; no radio-control intervention labels
fixed optimization budget with replacement, not full-data convergence
five observation steps with history-inferred ages; gap-filtered cohort
seed SD is not site-level uncertainty; only one small pretrained backbone
